description: This file defines the Document class within the Goteo project's Model layer, handling contract-related document uploads, validations, and database interactions. It manages file storage with external systems, validates file data, and provides methods for retrieving document records.

classes.name: Document
classes.description: Represents a contract-related document, handling file uploads, validation, storage, and retrieval within the Goteo platform.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Document instance, handling various input types (existing Document, UploadedFile, array, string).

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the document's properties, ensuring necessary data is present and error-free before saving.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Stores the document in the database and uploads the file to external storage if valid.

methods.name: isUploadedFile
methods.description: Checks whether the file was uploaded via HTTP POST.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the document file.

methods.name: toSymfonyFile
methods.description: Converts the Document instance to a Symfony File object.

methods.name: getLink
methods.description: Returns a URL to access the document, optionally as an absolute HTTP link.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Determines and returns the MIME type or extension of the document.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Fetches a Document by its ID from the database.

methods.name: getDocs
methods.description: Retrieves all documents associated with a specific contract ID.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes the document record from the database and its file from external storage.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves a Document by its filename.
